summary: Volato Group filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a registered direct offering of 11,038,767 shares of Class A common stock at $0.165 per share, raising gross proceeds of approximately $1.82 million. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration statement and exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, with no general solicitation or sales commissions. As this is a routine capital raise via a shelf takedown, not a special situation, the filing is not classified as an event-driven special situation.
